description: Sends the visit time the buyer confirmed. The dealership gets the buyer's name, phone number and email. It needs the previewToken that visit_times returned, and the same idempotencyKey as that visit_times call. Before the buyer has gone ahead with this car, it answers go_ahead_first.

idempotencyKey.description: The same key as the visit_times call: 1 to 255 printable characters.

previewToken.description: The previewToken from visit_times for the same time.

slot.description: The time from the visit_times answer the buyer confirmed.

instant.description: The visit time the buyer stated, in UTC, for example 2026-11-12T18:00:00.000Z, or any ISO 8601 time with a zone.

name: book_visit
title: Pick a time to visit
